tech.name: Tech & Gadgets
tech.blurb: Clever phone accessories and gadgets with character, from brands that stand behind them.
tech.intro: Phones run most of our day, so the gear around them should be clever, safe and genuine. Our tech guides look for accessories with a little imagination, like fold-flat stands, chargers with character and lenses that open up new shots, from well-known brands sold by established stores.
tech.lookForTitle: What we look for in tech

lookFor.title: Genuine brands, real stores
lookFor.body: We favour brands' own stores and established sellers, and we check model numbers against known recalls and look-alike shops.

lookFor.title: Independent evidence
lookFor.body: Manufacturer specs are a starting point. We look for independent reviews and tests, and link every one so you can read it yourself.

lookFor.title: Safe for daily use
lookFor.body: Chargers and power banks need clear ratings and capacity labels, which also matters for flights. If the safety story is unclear, it doesn't make the list.

phone-accessories.name: Phone accessories
phone-accessories.blurb: Chargers, cables, power banks, earbuds and more.

home.name: Home & Decor
home.blurb: Decor in good materials (glass, wood, ceramic and native fibres) for small spaces.
home.intro: Most of us live in condos and compact homes, where every piece has to earn its place. Our home guides start from a look worth living in, then build a short list of well-made pieces in honest materials that work together.
home.lookForTitle: What we look for in home and decor

lookFor.title: Pieces that work together
lookFor.body: We start from the look or the problem, list the pieces that create it, and only then search for products, so a guide reads like a plan, not a pile.

lookFor.title: Good materials, no plastic
lookFor.body: Glass, wood, stone, ceramic, cotton and native fibres like rattan, abaca, buri and capiz. If it looks or feels like cheap plastic, it does not make the list.

lookFor.title: Sellers with a track record
lookFor.body: Named brands, local makers and established stores with steady recent buyers, at prices that make sense for the item.

style-guides.name: Style guides
style-guides.blurb: Shop a look: MUJI-inspired, Japandi, Modern Filipino and boho.

holiday-decor.name: Holiday decor
holiday-decor.blurb: Seasonal decorating ideas for small spaces.

beauty.name: Beauty & Skin Care
beauty.blurb: Skin care and beauty finds, with extra care to steer clear of fakes.
beauty.intro: Beauty is the category where fakes and exaggerated claims are most common, so we're taking our time. Our first beauty guides are being researched now, and they'll only go live once we've found products we're comfortable recommending.

lookFor.title: Official and authorized sellers
lookFor.body: We'll only recommend beauty products sold by the brand's own store or an authorized seller, because that's the surest way to get the genuine item.

lookFor.title: Claims checked against sources
lookFor.body: We'll look at ingredient lists and claims and compare them with reputable sources, and say plainly when evidence is thin.

lookFor.title: Made for our weather
lookFor.body: We'll favour products that suit hot, humid days and a range of Filipino skin types, with notes on who each one is for.

seasonal.name: Seasonal Finds
seasonal.blurb: Christmas, sale seasons and the moments worth planning for.
seasonal.intro: From the ber months to the big sale days, some shopping is best done early. Our seasonal guides arrive ahead of the rush, with picks that suit small spaces and safety notes where they matter.
seasonal.lookForTitle: What we look for in seasonal finds

lookFor.title: Planned ahead
lookFor.body: Seasonal guides go up weeks before the big day, so you can shop calmly and avoid last-minute stock-outs.

lookFor.title: Safety first
lookFor.body: Lights and plug-in decor get extra scrutiny. We favour USB and battery options and explain the PS and ICC marks to look for.

lookFor.title: Made for small spaces
lookFor.body: Tabletop, wall and window ideas that bring the season home without crowding a condo.

christmas.name: Christmas
christmas.blurb: Parols, decor themes and small-condo ideas for a Pinoy Christmas.
